'''Sienar Intelligence Systems''' was a powerful branch of [[Santhe/Sienar Technologies]]. Sienar Intelligence Systems specialized in government contracts and its main rivals were [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] and [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]]. [[Black Ops]] was a top secret laboratory belonging to Sienar Intelligence Systems.
